items.title: Formation of the scheme theoretic image of a quasi-compact morphism commutes with flat base change
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that for a quasi-compact morphism of algebraic stacks the formation of the scheme theoretic image commutes with flat base change (author lemma at source lines 8884-8889, label lemma-existence-plus-flat-base-change). The proof (source lines 8891-8984) chooses flat smooth presentations adapted to the base change and reduces the assertion to three equalities of scheme theoretic images; the first and second are proved by the correspondence between closed substacks and invariant closed subspaces, computing two preimages as the scheme theoretic image of one morphism and using the flat base change statement for schemes together with the invariance of the image under a further smooth cover; the third is reduced componentwise to the scheme case (proof lines 8920-8983). The invariance argument through the presentation is the content. H3.
